newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's VA Tech jumps 1.44 pct on result.
newsitem.headline: Austria's VA Tech jumps 1.44 pct on result.

text.p: Shares in Austrian engineering group VA Technologie AG climbed 1.44 percent on buoyant trade after the group said it expected strong growth in turnover and pre-tax profit for 1996.
At 0940 GMT VA Tech stood at 829.0 schillings, up 26 from Wednesday's close on turnover of 14,000. The ATX index of 21 blue chips was up 0.57 percent at 1,215.40.
"The share is up on the strong results and because VA Tech is generally seen as a good company," said one trader.
The company said its order backlog in 1996 provisionally rose 22 percent to 81 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
